commands.Command: sc.exe create snxpsamd type= kernel binPath= C:\\windows\\temp\\snxpsamd.sys && sc.exe start snxpsamd
commands.Description: SUNIX Serial Driver x64 version 10.1.0.0 is affected by CVE-2024-55412. This exact signed build exposes raw I/O-port operations to low-privilege callers through IOCTLs including 0x9C403C04 and 0x9C403C08. An attacker can use the unrestricted port read/write primitives to disclose information, tamper with privileged hardware state, and elevate privileges.
commands.Usecase: Read and write arbitrary I/O ports
